headline: YouTube reportedly settling social media addiction claims for $3 billion.
summary: YouTube is preparing to pay $3 billion to settle claims of 'addictive design'. Thousands of school districts allege harm to kids. The deal includes new safeguards for teens.

headline: GTA VI shatters records with $3.79 billion in first-day sales.
summary: Rockstar Games announced GTA VI earned $3.79 billion on its launch day. This sets a new record for entertainment across any medium. The game also sold 32.5 million preorder copies.

headline: Eufy Omni C28 robot vacuum/mop now 53% off for Black Friday.
summary: Eufy's Omni C28 robot vacuum and mop hybrid is on sale. Get it for $379.99, a 53% discount ($420 off). Available at Amazon, Best Buy, or directly from Eufy.

headline: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on AI data centers built abroad.
summary: Donald Trump proposes a large tax on companies building data centers outside the US. He aims to prevent US companies from moving such infrastructure overseas. The threat comes as US states are already restricting new data center construction.

headline: Nitro Deck 2 for Nintendo Switch 2 gets Black Friday discount.
summary: The Nitro Deck 2 controller for Nintendo Switch 2 is on sale. It's receiving a Black Friday discount at Amazon. Enhance your Switch 2 gaming experience for less.

headline: How a $6 Beer in GTA 6 led to in-game crime and anxiety.
summary: A player's in-game experience with a $6 beer in GTA 6 is explored. The seemingly small purchase triggered a spiral of crime. It led to unexpected anxiety within the game's world.

headline: Official Lord of the Rings Pizza Cutter hits new low price on Amazon.
summary: The official Lord of the Rings pizza cutter is deeply discounted. It's reached a new low price on Amazon for Black Friday. A must-have collectible for LotR fans and pizza lovers.

headline: RayNeo Black Friday sale features AR glasses, new Call of Duty edition.
summary: RayNeo's Black Friday sale includes discounts on AR glasses. Save $94 on RayNeo GT Max AR Glasses and other models. A new GT Max Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Limited Edition is also released.

headline: Miliband: EU deal not dependent on tuition fees agreement.
summary: Ed Miliband states an EU deal is separate from tuition fee agreements. Brussels sources previously suggested fees for EU students might impact the deal. This clarifies a potential sticking point in ongoing negotiations.

headline: Zelensky calls Putin a 'killer' after Trump's friendly remarks.
summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky labels Putin a 'killer'. This follows Trump's recent friendly greeting with Putin in China. Trump had previously described having a 'great relationship' with Putin.

headline: Tech stock sell-off, Anthropic slide drag down US markets.
summary: US markets experienced a downturn due to a tech stock sell-off. Shares of AI firm Anthropic notably slid, adding pressure. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average entered correction territory.

headline: Man convicted of starting deadly Palisades fire in Los Angeles.
summary: A 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson. The arson led to the deadly Palisades wildfires. Fires killed 12 people and destroyed over 6,800 buildings.
